title: Session cookie goes with requests from other sites
summary: A cookie that looks like the session is set with SameSite=None, so the browser sends it on requests that other sites start.  Any form or action without a working request forgery check can then be triggered by a page the signed in user merely visits.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: curl -s -i https://host/login and read the Set-Cookie lines.  A session or sign in cookie carrying SameSite=None is sent on requests from any other site.
remediate: Set the session cookie to SameSite=Lax or Strict.  Keep a request forgery token on every state change as well, because SameSite does not cover sibling sites under the same domain.
